mobile.past.search_label.note: Accessible name of the search field on the Past sessions screen. Screen readers announce it; it is not drawn on screen (the placeholder is the visible hint). No final full stop.

mobile.past.search_placeholder.note: Placeholder inside the Past sessions search field: the search matches words from what was said, or the conversation's title. Must fit about 14 characters at the narrowest phone; shorter is better.

mobile.past.empty_headline.note: Headline of the Past sessions screen when the computer has no finished conversations. Plain statement, not an error.

mobile.past.empty_next.note: Second line under 'No past conversations yet.': what will appear on this screen and that a conversation can be resumed from it.

mobile.past.no_matches_next.note: Second line under 'Nothing matches that.' on the Past sessions screen: the search looks at the conversation text and titles, so trying a shorter word may find a match.
